_readme: An example custom-provider overlay. Copy this file to providers.local.json (same folder) — or paste its contents into the CUSTOM_PROVIDERS_JSON environment variable — and both provider loaders (shared/model-providers.ts and shared/model_providers.py) will register the providers below with no code change. Each row names its endpoint directly (base_url), the environment variable its API key arrives in (key_variable — the key itself never lives in this file), a default_model, and api (only "chat", OpenAI-compatible chat completions, is supported). An optional base_url_variable names the variable that can override base_url; when omitted it is derived from the id (9router -> PROVIDER_9ROUTER_BASE_URL). Optional bots entries may point a Bot at a custom provider. Select one for the built-in Bots with BOT_PROVIDER=9router (and BOT_MODEL to override its default model).
